title: Myeongri fusion decision ledger line (JSONL)
description: One JSON object per line in projects/bitcoin-trading/memory/v2/ledger/myeongri_decision_ledger_YYYYMMDD.jsonl. Writer: append_myeongri_decision_ledger() in ops/v2/memory/decision_ledger.py. Code uses spelling MYEONGRI; manifest label MYEONGNI_FUSION_DECISION_JSON_SCHEMA is the SSOT name for this artifact.

slice_id.description: Fusion slice identifier (e.g. regime or gate slice).

ledger_join_key.description: Field name used to join ledger rows (e.g. run_id).

stub.description: Optional stub or cycle tag (string or boolean in experiments).

ts_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp; defaulted by append_myeongri_decision_ledger if omitted before write.

fact_lock.description: Caller-supplied or build_fact_lock(project_root) snapshot; error stub if unavailable.
